note: Triennial election of the rural district council, due on Thursday 5 June 1930. Nine nominations (LS 9 May 1930 p5): eight divisions with a single nominee and two nominees in Ballyscolly, where Robert Beckett withdrew (LS 16 May 1930 p5), so no poll anywhere; no nominations in Derriaghy, Glenavy, Lambeg, Lisnagarvey, Magheramesk and Ballinderry, whose retiring members were automatically returned. Nominated with Robert Beckett (LS 9 May 1930 p5); Beckett withdrew and Buchanan was returned unopposed (LS 16 May 1930 p5). Returned unopposed.
